verdict.rationale: The product ships its own command-line Python scripts, invoked directly, for example `python3 replica-design/contrast.py` for WCAG contrast checks, and the docs say there are six standard-library scripts. That is minimal first-party CLI tooling. The main interface is slash commands and /plugin install inside Claude Code, which is the host platform and earns no credit. missing for 10: a unified, documented official CLI with commands covering the workflow (recon, build, parity, deploy), install and usage docs for a standalone CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Six of them, all standard-library Python. None touch the network.
